GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-07-11T14:35:08Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Remove alpha channel from png output
Description: Hi I try to compose an `icon.png` (with 4 channels) onto a background.
Right now my solution is like this
```js
const icon = sharp('icon.png').resize(size)
sharp({ create: { width, height, background, channels: 4 } })
  .overlayWith(await icon.toBuffer())
  .toFile('output.png')
```

Now I sometimes need to remove the alpha channel from the `output.png`,
I tried using `.flatten()` but the output image still has 4 channels.
It only worked when I also `.flatten()` the `icon` but then I get problems with the overlay.

Is there a solution for this or do I have thought error somewhere?
Thank you for your help.
